_note: Drowsiness 0..100. It rises while awake and resting-still, falls fast while sleeping. A hunter inside disturb_radius (Godot SLEEP_WAKE_DISTANCE 5) jolts a sleeper awake and costs jolt_penalty drowsiness (the sleeper wakes shaken). Falling asleep by drowsiness alone happens at pass_out.

bed._note: Lying on a bed and sleeping in it (game/bed.rs, docs/SLEEP.md; Godot docs/REST_AND_SLEEP.md). prop_rules: the first rule that matches a prop type (lower case) names its seat kind of data/seating.json (Godot: types ending in Bed, plus bunks). The eye lies eye_above_mattress over the seat height, head_inset metres in from the pillow end, and eases there in ease_seconds. The look is held around the bed's length: look_yaw_limit_deg each side, look_pitch_down_deg below and look_pitch_up_deg above level; look_pitch is the pitch on lying down (radians). Asleep: stamina_per_s more stamina a second, the screen darkens by dark_in_per_s up to dark_alpha, a hunter inside stir_radius gives the stir cue every stir_cooldown_s. In text, {fatigue} is the drowsiness in percent.

text.lying: LYING DOWN // FATIGUE {fatigue}% // [SPACE] SLEEP // [E] GET UP
